title: Controlled random pattern.
officialText:
There shall be a minimum distance of 24 inches (610 mm) between end
joints in adjacent courses. The pieces in the first and second courses shall bear on at least two supports with end
joints in these two courses occurring on alternate supports. A maximum of seven intervening courses shall be
permitted before this pattern is repeated.
